conventions.cache_note: Server-side KV cache. Cache hits billed at input_cache_hit price ("cache miss" in the official pricing table = the plain input price).
conventions.v4_pro_discount_note: Historical tiers: deepseek-v4-pro's 75%-off promotion ended 2026-05-31T15:59:00Z; standard and undiscounted retain the same post-promotion price. The 2026-08-16 pricing update superseded these tiers.
conventions.price_update_2026_08_16_note: Peak/off-peak pricing effective 2026-08-16T16:00:00Z is stored under standard_2026_08_16 / standard_2026_08_16_peak. These remain the current published Pro rates: off-peak input cache hits $0.022, input cache misses $0.66, and output $1.98 per 1M tokens; peak rates are 2x. Flash subsequently moved to the 2026-09-10 tiers. Earlier tiers are retained for historical estimates.
conventions.price_update_2026_09_10_note: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash (API model name: deepseek-flash; legacy deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp names remain accepted) uses the new pricing from 2026-09-10T04:00:00Z (12:00 Beijing Time). Off-peak rates are $0.003 per 1M tokens for input cache hits, $0.15 for input cache misses, and $0.60 for output; peak rates are exactly 2x. Stored under standard_2026_09_10 / standard_2026_09_10_peak for deepseek-flash. PriceManager switches the Flash series to these tiers at the cutover.
conventions.current_pricing_note: Verified 2026-10-20: the official pricing page lists deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017) and deepseek-v4-pro (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) as separate models with their own prices; it no longer states that Pro requests are served by Flash. Current token prices are already stored in the dated tiers identified by metadata.current_tiers.
conventions.peak_pricing_note: All token billing dimensions cost 2x the off-peak rate during 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC (09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 UTC+8), Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. Weekends, Chinese public holidays, and all other hours use off-peak rates. The base tiers store off-peak prices; *_peak variants store peak prices.

peak_pricing.applies_to: all billing dimensions (input, input_cache_hit, output) across all tiers
peak_pricing.peak_days: Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; weekends and Chinese public holidays are entirely off-peak
peak_pricing.holiday_estimation_note: Cost estimates intentionally use regular weekday peak windows without annual Chinese public holiday adjustments.
peak_pricing.off_peak_note: Off-peak rate = half the peak rate. The base (non-_peak) tiers store the off-peak price.

search_fetch_pricing.billing_rule: Bill only HTTP 200 responses containing results: non-empty search results or fetched page content. Errors, empty searches, and timeouts are free; search result count does not change the request price.

server_side_tool_calls.note: Server-side Search/Fetch calls through these integrations are free before 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC+8; thereafter the per-request rates above apply.
